mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (title, content, user_id, type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{type}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET forwards = forwards + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET likes = likes - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND likes > 0
UPDATE post SET views = IFNULL(views, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET comments = comments + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comments = comments - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND comments > 0
